text.tspan: Option 4 · Remove the overlap: a new VPC with a unique CIDR, then move the apps blue/green
AWS VPC IPAM pool (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8 split per region and team)
hands out a unique CIDR to every new VPC, so this can never happen again
1 · Get a unique CIDR from IPAM.
2 · Build VPC B2 and the new cluster from the same Terraform and GitOps code.
3 · Shift traffic with DNS weights, watching error rates at each step.
4 · Retire the old VPC B. Slow, but it's the real fix: every other option only works around the overlap.
peering or TGW now works: no overlap
